value.rationale: An exact, testable covariance-only phase criterion separates one-time angular-momentum laws with and without any exponential fluctuation relation despite having nonzero mean currents. An explicit two-temperature thermally driven harmonic gyrator violates the relation, while a sharp realizable family attains an asymmetric-Laplace benchmark. This contributes information about a natural measured fluctuation distribution beyond source plots and known Gaussian algebra, without claiming a full nonlinear theorem.
